questions.question: If CALENDAR is coded as 91452313 and FACEMASK is coded as 210142316, then how will SECURITY be coded as?
questions.solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Step 1: Consonants coded as 

 
• **If consonants place value has two-digit coded as the digit sum with each other.**
 
• If consonants place value has one-digit coded as place value.

Step 2: Vowel’s coded as position number of vowel’s position like,

A = 1; E = 2; I = 3; O = 4; U = 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab7b1d16d7343bf4b81e0605086da24c70b9a327708186337b705592df19cf7.png] 

Step 3: After being coded as a number the number is arranged in reverse order.

CALENDAR is coded as 91452313

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef0290898ccf8bfbf1b5c9de204cbf3bb645839e04c422b8379ea5e2a90326d8.png] 

Reverse order → 9 1 4 5 2 3 1 3

And,

FACEMASK is coded as 210142316

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1af5bf084dbfc4abe682633c83c85e4196b3ba41d17e21dd38cd9ab2f0c358b8.png] 

Reverse order → 2 10 1 4 2 3 1 6

Similarly,

**SECURITY = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61759f8d983c84e40f3a51d91e9f807eebb8b809b69b61923d2e99fee2cccbde.png] 

Reverse order → 7 2 3 9 5 3 2 10

Hence, 'SECURITY' is coded as "**723953210**".

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘BACK’ is coded as ‘2325215’, ‘CAME’ is coded as ‘2125117’. What is the code for ‘GBJH’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

**Logic: Place value of Opposite letter - Positional value of given letter**

‘BACK’ is coded as ‘2325215

B → Y(25) - B(2) = 23

A → Z(26) - A(1) = 25

C → X(24) - C(3) = 21

K → P(16) - K(11) = 5

‘CAME’ is coded as ‘2125117

C → X(24) - C(3) = 21

A → Z(26) - A(1) = 25

M → N(14) - M(13) = 1

E → V(22) - E(5) = 17

Similarly,

G → T (20) - G (7) = 13

B → Y (25) - B (2) = 23

J → Q(17) - J (10) = 7

H → S(19) - H (8) = 11

Hence, the correct answer is **1323711.**

questions.question: In a certain code language, NIB is coded as 112 and COB is coded as 122. How will JET be coded as in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f086f29a8fea1015dbcacde77f4cff7d3cf94f6f137b3463828316ca1f2e7c.png] 

The pattern followed is,

Sum of reverse positional value of letters and multiplied by 2.

NIB = (13 + 18 + 25) × 2 = 112

COB = (24 + 12 + 25) × 2 = 122

Similarly, 

JET = (17 + 22 + 7) × 2 = 92

Hence, 92 is the correct answer.
